homeo_flow_temp_reason: 39.0 °C is higher than the upper teaching limit of 37.5 °C. This comparison describes the range; it does not diagnose a person.
homeo_flow_ph_reason: 7.25 is below 7.35. A lower pH is more acidic; a higher pH is more alkaline.
homeo_flow_feedback_reason: Negative feedback opposes a disturbance. In the temperature comparison, the active response becomes smaller as the difference from the starting value gets smaller.
homeo_flow_measurements_reset: Measurements reset. Your writing, observations and check answers are saved.
homeo_flow_observations_cleared: Observations cleared. Your writing and check answers are saved.
homeo_flow_checks_restarted: New check attempt. Your last completed score and written work are saved.
homeo_flow_prediction_again: Make a new prediction. Your explanation is saved.
homeo_flow_models_compared: Model comparison shown. Read the explanation and compare the two lines.
homeo_flow_intro: Predict how temperature feedback responds, then explore three teaching reference ranges. Your writing and observations stay saved while you move between these activities.
homeo_flow_range_intro: Adjust body temperature, arterial blood pH and fasting plasma glucose. Compare each value with its own adult teaching range; the measurements use different units.
homeo_flow_outside_count: {outside} of {total} measurements are outside the teaching reference ranges.
homeo_flow_reset_help: Reset measurements restores the three starting values. Clear observations removes the table. Both keep your writing and check answers.
homeo_flow_explanation: Explain the limits of the reference ranges
homeo_flow_restart_help: Restart clears the answers in this attempt. Your last completed score, writing and observations stay saved.
